shortDescription: Bira 91 maker B9 Beverages' new board led by Anicut Capital has offered to buy shares of existing investors such as Japan's Kirin Holdings, Peak XV Partners and Belgium's Sofina. Ratna Bhushan & Mohit Bhalla report.

title: Bira 91 Board Offers to Buy Out Existing Investors
